text: My daily routine is quite simple and organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and some stretching. After a quick breakfast, I get ready for work and begin my job at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short lunch break in between. Later, I go to the gym or take a walk in the park to stay active. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book. I try to keep this routine consistent because it helps me feel balanced and productive.
